label: Spotlight
description: Dim the frame and open a feathered window on the part of the screen that matters. With targets, the window GLIDES from target to target on the words (rounded rect or circle, a thin accent ring, a pulse on each arrival, an optional label chip) -- point at the button, then the chart, then the result. Place it full-frame ABOVE the screen it points at. Without targets it is a plain round spotlight at x/y.

targets.label: Targets: { at (seconds or "@word"), x, y (CENTRE, % of frame), w, h (% of frame), label (optional chip text), shape ("rect" | "circle") }. The window lands on the first at its time and glides to each next one on its word.

dim.label: How dark the rest of the frame goes (0-0.92)

padding.label: Room around each target in px

ring.label: Thin accent ring on the window (default on)

color.label: Accent for the ring, pulse and label (default brand primary); legacy mode: glow color

exit_at.label: When it fades away (seconds or "@word"; default near the end)
